svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How Ragis answers
svg.desc: Multimodal parsing into typed content units, a dual text and cross-modal knowledge graph with a vector index, and cross-modal hybrid retrieval with verified citations.
svg.text: How Ragis answers: multimodal RAG over a cross-modal knowledge graph
Each file becomes typed content units, a dual knowledge graph and one vector space; a question is answered only from evidence the person is allowed to read.
Every chunk, entity, relation and vector keeps its source
chunk; the document ACL decides who sees it (RLS forced).
every [n] and figure in the evidence
restricted data never leaves the network;
no silent fallback to the cloud.
Structure inspired by RAG-Anything (Guo et al., 2025), implemented inside PostgreSQL. Decisions: ADR-018 (multimodal), ADR-019 (graph), ADR-029 (cross-modal graph), ADR-030 (audio).
